history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration request the entities to review the use of temporary appointments and reiterates to entities the need to use temporary appointments to meet only short-term needs that are of temporary nature.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented. The Administration has reiterated to entities, through the revised policy and broadcast, that temporary appointments should be used only for short-term needs. The Administration has also reiterated that entities should consider the use of fixed- term appointments or the fixed-term appointment-limited modality in lieu of temporary appointments for positions of one year or longer. The Administration respectfully requests the closure of the recommendation because it has clearly demonstrated that it has implemented the measures required.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has reiterated to entities the need to use the fixed-term appointment-limited modality instead of temporary appointments in the scenario mentioned in the audit finding that led to the recommendation, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
